question: B4 showed grip helps but the controllers were trained without it. If the residual is trained WITH the declared normal adhesion present, can per-leg material slip reach 0.5 while support and height stay acceptable?
environment: identical to residual v2 except the declared normal adhesion channel is active during training as well: A = 0.5 W per loaded leg, shared across that leg's contacts, applied every 0.5 ms, only when normal load > 0.1 W
unchanged: reward definition (per-leg slip hinge at 0.35 plus stance foot-speed penalty)
budget: 16 updates at the first curriculum level (v=0.05) only, then evaluation with adhesion ON and OFF
labelling: any pass here is a derived-channel pass and does NOT change the frozen-body status, which remains unaccepted
failure_rule: if slip stays above 0.5 with adhesion ON after the allocated updates, the negative result is reported and no weight, cap or threshold is changed
